programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo is in Crewe, a town steeped in railway history and immortalised in Victorian music hall, to investigate the making of the iconic cinema classic The Night Mail during the 1930s.

programme.title: Wainwright's Walks: Coast to Coast
programme.desc: Julia sets off across the Eden Valley, a sparse land today but full of signs of ancient and uncertain human habitation. Kirkby Stephen is the one bustling modern outpost on this section, the launchpad for Julia's climb up and over the Pennines. The spine of England is a landmark on the walk, but during the wettest autumn in memory it is a major, boggy challenge.

programme.title: Digging for Britain
programme.desc: A look at the camp from which Vikings invaded Britain, and groundbreaking evidence that the world-famous Avebury stone circle isn't just a sacred site but a place where people lived and worked. In Staffordshire, the oldest Iron Age gold in Britain is unearthed.

programme.title: Little Ships - The Miracle of Dunkirk
programme.desc: To mark the 70th anniversary of the `miracle of Dunkirk', fifty of the surviving `Little Ships' which made the original perilous cross-channel voyage, are returning to France. Dan Snow tells the extraordinary story of these Little Ships, their role in the evacuation and the people who struggled to keep them afloat today during those fateful days in 1940, when the future of Europe hung in the balance.

programme.title: Where Eagles Dare
programme.desc: World War II espionage thriller scripted by Alistair MacLean from his bestseller. An elite squad of commandos are dispatched to rescue an American general held by the Nazis in a castle fortress in the Bavarian Alps. From the moment they parachute behind enemy lines, however, it becomes apparent that they face not only the might of the German army, but also a traitor in their midst.

programme.title: Arena
programme.sub-title: Clint Eastwood: Part One - Out of the West
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood recalls his tough childhood and looks back at his early career, from `Rawhide' to `Dirty Harry' and the spaghetti westerns. With contributions from Don Siegel, Sergio Leone, Eli Wallach and Martin Scorcese, plus an exclusive interview with his mother, Ruth.

programme.title: Kelly's Heroes
programme.desc: World War II adventure about an American soldier who captures a German officer and discovers that his prisoner knows the whereabouts of $16 million in Nazi gold. Getting the colonel drunk, he finds out where the bullion is - it's lying behind enemy lines. The soldier quickly gathers a crew of military misfits to help him with his unusual and daring robbery.

programme.title: Arena
programme.sub-title: Clint Eastwood: Part Two - American Film-maker
programme.desc: Arena's profile of Clint Eastwood continues with his directorial debut, `Play Misty for Me', which he completed in five weeks before going on to huge success in `Dirty Harry'. Featuring actors Gene Hackman and Meryl Streep, director Martin Scorsese, plus Eastwood's mother Ruth and wife Dina.

programme.title: Arena

programme.title: How the Wild West Was Won with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears looks at how the landscapes of America's three great mountain ranges, the Appalachians, the Rockies and the Sierra Nevada, challenged the westward push of the early pioneers. As Ray travels through each landscape he discovers how their awe-inspiring geography, extreme weather, wild animals and ecology presented both great opportunities and great challenges for the native Indians, mountain men, fur traders, wagon trains and gold miners of the Wild West.

programme.title: Eurythmics at the BBC
programme.desc: A collection of Eurythmics' best moments from the BBC's music archives, showcasing the bold, innovative, stylish and unpredictable pair who became one of Britain's biggest bands of the 1980's.

programme.title: TOTP 2
programme.desc: We dip into the archives to explore both classic collective hits and smash solo singles spanning 20 early years of Genesis history. With solo numbers from Peter Gabriel, Phil Collins and Mike and the Mechanics.

programme.title: Young Guns Go for It
programme.desc: Members past and present talk about the three distinct groups that have existed under the banner of The Human League, the Sheffield synthesiser band that enjoyed huge commercial success.

programme.title: Young Guns Go for It
programme.desc: Manchester's The Smiths formed around the formidable songwriting talents of guitarist Johnny Marr and lyricist and singer Morrissey. Their sensitive and introspective reaction to Thatcher's Britain created an obsessive fanbase. Featuring Johnny Marr.

programme.title: The 80s: Music's Greatest Decade?
programme.desc: The 1980s was an era in which a fusillade of new genres emerged, and many are still here today, such as hip-hop and house. Dylan Jones has mined the archives to select some of the most crucial tracks in the rise of these two genres. From a young Kurtis Blow making his `Top of the Pops' debut to the sonic bombardment of Public Enemy and the sampling skills of Bomb the Bass, this is a showcase of the evolution in rap and house music across the decade.

programme.title: Wild
programme.desc: Documentary about the community of wild red squirrels on the island of Brownsea in Poole harbour. The squirrels share their island with breeding colonies of birds, timid sika deer and migrants which stop off at the island to refuel.

programme.title: All Creatures Great & Small
programme.desc: Appearances prove deceptive when an old school friend of James's comes to visit and thinks the vet's life is idyllic.

programme.title: All Creatures Great & Small
programme.desc: James and Helen are proud parents when Jimmy is asked to play in his piano teacher's music recital. Calum is supposed to collect Deirdre at the train station but finds himself literally up a tree when he's charged by a bull and the time has come again for Kit Bilton to slaughter his pig.

programme.title: The Black Forest Murders
programme.desc: When DCI Barbara Kramer and her colleague Thomas Riedle get the message that a young woman from Buchingen has not returned home from a run, the local force and concerned villagers have already been searching for her for 17 hours. They face an uphill struggle to prevent evidence from being destroyed, a contingency which becomes more salient when a body is discovered 72 hours later. In German with English subtitles.

programme.title: The Black Forest Murders
programme.desc: Despite the team working many hours of overtime on the Berghoff case, there are still few leads to follow. The forensic team is able to isolate the DNA of an unknown male, but the databases do not provide a match. The discovery of a second body less than 20 miles away leads the team to believe a serial killer is at work.

programme.title: Bob Servant Independent
programme.desc: Bob tricks his way on to TV, but a news report makes him a laughing stock around Broughty Ferry. He recruits his mother Margo for some much-needed damage limitation.

programme.title: Bob Servant Independent
programme.desc: Bob is in trouble and he knows it. A by-election debate, in front of a live audience, is his last chance for glory, but he's running unusually low on ideas. Can he pull himself together and win over the crowd ahead of election day?

programme.title: Bob Servant Independent
programme.desc: A reinvigorated Bob and Frank embark on a final push for votes, but a confrontation with Bob's first ever boo boy leaves them on the run from the police. Bob keeps his head held high as they wait for the election results. Surely he can't win?

programme.title: Amol Rajan Interviews
programme.desc: The actor Brian Cox, star of the drama `Succession', sits down with Amol Rajan to reveal the secrets of the show and what took him from poverty in Dundee all the way to Hollywood. The award-winning theatre, television and film actor reveals what really happens on set, his thoughts on the method acting technique used by one of his co-stars, and his best and worst moments since the show first aired in 2018.

programme.title: The Good Life
programme.desc: Tom and Barbara receive help from an unexpected quarter when harvest time comes around and Tom sprains his back. It's a treat to see Margo dressed for horticultural action, with Jerry in tow.
